platform.cpu: 6-core CPU with 2 super cores and 4 efficiency cores

charging.claim: Up to 50% in around 15 min wired (60 W adapter or higher); up to 50% in 30 min on MagSafe (35 W adapter or higher)

rear_detail: 48MP Fusion Main with variable aperture (ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8, ƒ/4.0): 24mm, second-generation sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels, super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP)
Also enables 12MP optical-quality 2x Telephoto: 48mm, second-generation sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels
48MP Fusion Ultra Wide: 13mm, ƒ/2.2 aperture and 120° field of view, Hybrid Focus Pixels, super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP)
48MP Fusion Telephoto: 100mm (4x), ƒ/2.8 aperture, Hybrid Focus Pixels, 3D sensor-shift optical image stabilisation and autofocus, tetraprism design, super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP)
Also enables 12MP optical-quality 8x Telephoto: 200mm, ƒ/2.8 aperture, Hybrid Focus Pixels, 3D sensor-shift optical image stabilisation and autofocus, tetraprism design
camera.features: 8x optical-quality zoom in, 2x optical zoom out; 16x optical-quality zoom range; Digital zoom up to 40x

connectivity.positioning: Precision dual-frequency GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou and NavIC); Digital compass; Wi-Fi; Mobile Data
connectivity.sim: Dual SIM (nano-SIM and eSIM); Dual eSIM support

specs.sensors: Face ID, LiDAR scanner, Barometer, High dynamic range gyro, High-g accelerometer, Proximity sensor, Dual ambient light sensors
